roles.title: Builder
roles.about:
# Builder

Makes the change the plan asks for, with a test next to it.

roles.title: Planner
roles.about:
# Planner

Turns a goal into a short plan and keeps each version small.

- Writes the first draft
- Asks the others to review each version
- Decides when the work is done

roles.title: Reviewer
roles.about:
# Reviewer

Reads each version as a new user would and says what is unclear.
